title: covellia ulmifolia
intro: Covellia ulmifolia, commonly known as the Madder tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and acting as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents present in Covellia ulmifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, alleviate oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer activities.
